notes.title: Demo Reopened!
notes.content:
Hi! The demo is reopened.
Please start a new game, dont use old game saves!
Update:
1 Reworked main character and all troops
2 Reworked Strategy world map, now the demo region has 7 locations where  our band can visit
3 New search scene: Vine pit added
4 2 new battle scene: life tree, water portal added, our band can fight and occupy them to produce resources
5 Talents system introduced, can unlock talents to enhance our abilities
And many more contents cant be listed here

notes.title: Demo will reopen soon
notes.content: Hi, everyone, the TunsTan demo will reopen around Sep 2024, with some major update, see you then!
